pilot.heading: The pilot
pilot.text: I am Wojciech Krupa, a software engineer at Bee Robotics. I build .NET and WPF interfaces and control routines for robotic systems, and I hold a B.Eng. in Aeronautics and Space Technology.
pilot.imageAlt: Portrait of Wojciech Krupa, smiling, in a dark blazer and a light blue shirt.
